root_cause.text: Missing cond_resched() in the bpf_fd_array_map_clear() loop for PROG_ARRAY maps, allowing a long-running loop that calls expensive per-entry operations via prog_array_map_poke_run() to monopolize the CPU and trigger RCU stalls.
